issues.description: The Person REST endpoints use inconsistent types for the {personId} path variable: the delete endpoint expects a UUID while the update endpoint takes a String. This differs from the Note endpoints which consistently use UUID for path variables. This inconsistency can confuse students about the expected type for personId and may lead to mismatching implementations between client and server.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent type for the personId path variable across all Person endpoints (prefer UUID like the Note endpoints). Change the update endpoint signature to accept a UUID path variable, e.g. @PutMapping("persons/{personId}") public ResponseEntity<Person> updatePerson(@RequestBody Person updatedPerson, @PathVariable("personId") UUID personId) and compare updatedPerson.getId().equals(personId). Update any client code accordingly to pass UUIDs.
